doc: documentation/C4_DESIGN.md §6, TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE §12.3 — two real-history cards of Chapter 4 part 1 (presented outside the fiction as „REALE GESCHICHTE“). Texts: data/locale/de_history_c4.json. hist.soviet.order_270 is unlocked by karsk.tunnels.lev_photo (Lev, a prisoner of war 1941–53, his granddaughter turned down because of a questionnaire line) and complements hist.soviet.filtration (what followed the return) with what came before it. hist.soviet.special_settlements is unlocked by karsk.tunnels.stovepipes (the kit that turns a freight wagon into a wagon for people) and complements hist.soviet.deportations (the deportations themselves) with the settlement regime and the unequal returns after 1955. Topic swap against the brief (C4_DESIGN §6 suggested hist.soviet.volga_germans): the Volga Germans are covered as one group of the special settlements, with the returns the lead asked for. Faktengeprüft am 06.11.2026 gegen mindestens zwei unabhängige Quellen je Aussage (Primärtext des Befehls auf Wikisource, bpb/DHM für die Gefangenenzahlen, MSU-Konferenzbeitrag zum Beschluss vom 29.06.1956, Erlass Nr. 63 vom 24.01.1995; bpb zu den Russlanddeutschen, Quaestio Rossica zum Erlass vom 26.11.1948, Wikisource zu den Erlassen vom 09.01.1957, Überblick zur Rückkehr der Krimtataren).
